decisionLog.outcome: Reset 2.2.2 under Andrew Wright, retiring the inherited delivery steps and resource assumptions and redrafting the proposition around partnership infrastructure, access funding, alumni and philanthropy. The proposition is now ready for informal stakeholder sense-check before formal Delivery design.

Rebased the recommended Core planning assumption for partnership infrastructure from £600,000 to £400,000 p.a. from 2027/28, while preserving Year 1 discovery and the requirement to produce lean, Core and more ambitious operating-model options from evidence. Student Opportunities Fund design remains within 2.2.2, but any new award pot is explicitly outside the King's Edge mobilisation ask and requires a separate institutional, consolidated-fund, philanthropic or other funding route.

decisionLog.forum: King's Edge Delivery Plan working update
decisionLog.outcome: Broaden 2.2.2 into Future-Proofed Employability & Experiential Infrastructure. Preserve the existing experiential partnership, access-funding, alumni and philanthropy work; add dedicated international employer-engagement, proactive graduate-transition and incremental global-mobility opportunity-development capability; and retain a reduced £300,000 p.a. Core envelope for domestic experiential opportunity translation and partnership infrastructure from 2027/28. Andrew Wright leads the deliverable with Eleanor Hannan as co-lead. The specified staffing package is 1 x G6 and 3 x G5 international employer-engagement roles, 1 x G7 plus 1 x G6 Graduate Transitions roles, and 1 x G6 plus 1 x G5 Global Mobility opportunity-development roles, alongside a £50,000 international employer-engagement non-pay envelope. The first international G6 and East Asia G5 are targeted for immediate mobilisation, Graduate Transitions from May 2027, and the remaining international and Global Mobility roles from September 2027. All grade-based staffing figures are to be treated as fully loaded planning costs including employer National Insurance and pension/superannuation, subject to Finance/HR validation before approval. On the current role-cost basis, specified staffing is £449,969 annualised; with £50,000 non-pay and the £300,000 domestic experiential-infrastructure envelope, the fully mobilised annualised Core ask for 2.2.2 is £799,969, excluding any separately funded Student Opportunities Fund award pot.
